name: Camp William Hinds
description_short: Scout summer camp on Panther Pond in Raymond, Maine, where Scouts come for a week with their troop. Mornings go to merit badges at the waterfront, STEM center, craft shop, shooting ranges and nature area; afternoons bring troop activities, and evenings end with campfires.
swim_waterfront_notes: Over 300 acres on Panther Pond in the Sebago Lakes region; merit badge work happens at the camp's waterfronts.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 dates and fees: early bird $535 until April 30, 2026, regular $585 per Scout. Camperships, sibling and multiple week discounts. Troops bring adult leaders (2 free for 2 to 8 Scouts, $120 for extra leaders).
Researched by Claude from this page.

source.title: Register for Camp - Camp William Hinds

warnings: This is a Scouting America troop camp. Scouts usually come with their troop; a staff run provisional troop (Troop H) lets a Scout attend alone (program page).
Only 2026 dates and fees are posted; nothing for 2027 yet.
